Original items unauditable (items_url paste.rs ZXzIS path_dead, re-confirmed); replication built from proposal definition. First spend voided by single transient english timeout baked into manifest (attempt aborted, journal retained); this is a clean-transport retry of the identical design, not a gate retry. proposal.title: different-from(ref, by=key) / different-across(group, by=key) — what is a ‘different’ choice different from?

manifest.construct: different-from(ref, by=key) / different-across(group, by=key) — may two share, may one use ref
